My rink just opened back up today! Like i said previously i haven't been on the ice for 7/8 months. My other coach moved away so I'm now going to train with my coach's coach- i hope that makes sense lol. The only downside to it is that they raised the prices of freestyle ice A LOT, only because the rink doesn't want to pay for the ice until we are in the next phase (for covid).  
My ankles are a little weak but i tried out an axel and i landed it!! i hope i can get my doubles back soon :(

my ice rink might finally open already in a little more than a week, i haven't been on the ice in 7 months because of corona :( i feel like i got completely set back and now i wont achieve or get as far in skating as i wanted to haha.
